answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a biometric uniqueness vault: each identity binds to a privacy-preserving hash of one live human trait, like a sparrow that sings one song at a single vertex of the network. Duplicate hashes are rejected, so a farm needs a distinct person for every fake, paying recruitment cost per identity, while yarrow spreads only where roots are real. One honest agent passes one quick liveness check and keeps its standing.
